stories.title: Prepare a Staff Fragment
stories.summary: Bring Eckraldu's staff to Lord Krimeneha to obtain a fragment that can free the sane spirits. This preparation exchange supports the rescues.

steps.text: Carry a steel key for the office
steps.hint: The crying ghost carries a steel key; a mad guest can carry another. It opens the office off the library. A supplied key or an already accessible office also works.

steps.text: Carry 1 x Eckraldu's staff
steps.hint: Eckraldu carries this staff. He can wander into the surrounding lands; the mansion is his source, not a promise of his current location. A supplied staff works too.

steps.text: Ask Lord Krimeneha to break the staff
steps.hint: Find his ghost in the office off the library. The exchange supplies one reusable fragment; it does not free the family by itself.

stories.title: Release the Second Gardener
stories.summary: Free the elderly gardener to receive a metal band that opens the stone chest under the pool. He also knows who poisoned the garden.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment with Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of a staff
steps.hint: Lord Krimeneha can supply a fragment in exchange for Eckraldu's staff. Each successful spirit rescue supplies another fragment; a gifted fragment is also accepted.

steps.text: Free the elderly gardener and receive the chest key
steps.hint: The elderly gardener starts in the overgrown garden. Ask about lord to learn of Eckraldu.

stories.title: Release the First Gardener
stories.summary: Free the younger gardener with a fragment. His account of the pool explains the disaster, and his release stands on its own.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment with Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of a staff
steps.hint: Lord Krimeneha can supply a fragment in exchange for Eckraldu's staff. Each successful spirit rescue supplies another fragment; a gifted fragment is also accepted.

steps.text: Free the younger gardener
steps.hint: The younger gardener starts in the indoor fountain sitting room. Ask about pool, monster and lord; the older gardener knows who caused the curse.

stories.title: Release the Crying Ghost
stories.summary: Free the crying ghost to receive the elegant key for the Lady's rooms. Keep the supplied fragment for the other rescues.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment with Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of a staff
steps.hint: Lord Krimeneha can supply a fragment in exchange for Eckraldu's staff. Each successful spirit rescue supplies another fragment; a gifted fragment is also accepted.

steps.text: Free the crying ghost and receive the elegant key
steps.hint: The crying ghost is upstairs near the children's rooms. Ask about crying, leave and lord to hear what happened.

stories.title: Release the Lady
stories.summary: Free the Lady with a fragment and keep her silver broach for the family reunion. The fragment is supplied again for another rescue.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment with Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Carry the elegant key for the Lady's rooms
steps.hint: The crying ghost rewards this key when freed; some mad ghosts also carry it. It opens the upstairs east door, distinct from the office's steel key.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of a staff
steps.hint: Lord Krimeneha can supply a fragment in exchange for Eckraldu's staff. Each successful spirit rescue supplies another fragment; a gifted fragment is also accepted.

steps.text: Receive the Lady's silver broach
steps.hint: Her bedroom is beyond the upstairs east door. The crying ghost supplies the elegant key for that door; a supplied key also works.

stories.title: Release the Boy
stories.summary: Free the boy with a fragment and keep his signet ring for Lord Krimeneha. The fragment can be used again.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment with Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Receive the boy's signet ring
steps.hint: Find the boy upstairs beyond his locked bedroom door. That ordinary lock has no matching named quest key; bring suitable access help.

stories.title: Release the Young Girl
stories.summary: Free the young girl with a fragment and keep her broach for Lord Krimeneha. The fragment can be used again.

steps.hint: Find the young girl upstairs beyond her locked bedroom door. That ordinary lock has no matching named quest key; bring suitable access help.

stories.title: Release the Serving Girl
stories.summary: Free the serving girl with a fragment. She has no extra keepsake, but her release is a complete rescue.

steps.hint: Optional local route. Possessing a valid supplied fragment is enough for this rescue.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a piece of a staff
steps.hint: Lord Krimeneha can supply a fragment in exchange for Eckraldu's staff. Each successful spirit rescue supplies another fragment; a gifted fragment is also accepted.

steps.text: Free the serving girl
steps.hint: Look for the serving girl's ghost in the mansion's wide hallway.

stories.title: Release the Haunted Family
stories.summary: Return the boy's ring, the girl's broach and the Lady's silver broach to release Lord Krimeneha. Freeing other sane spirits is encouraged and recorded separately. Supplied keepsakes are accepted.

steps.text: Carry a steel key for the office
steps.hint: The crying ghost carries a steel key; a mad guest can carry another. It opens the office off the library. A supplied key or an already accessible office also works.

steps.text: Prepare a staff fragment
steps.hint: Optional route for obtaining the three keepsakes. Supplied keepsakes do not require earlier rescue receipts.

steps.text: Free the boy
steps.hint: An optional earlier rescue; its receipt is distinct from the lord's final exchange.

steps.text: Free the young girl
steps.hint: An optional earlier rescue; its receipt is distinct from the lord's final exchange.

steps.text: Free the Lady
steps.hint: An optional earlier rescue; its receipt is distinct from the lord's final exchange.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a boy's signet ring
steps.hint: Free the boy with a staff fragment to receive his ring. Another valid supplied ring works too.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a girl's broach
steps.hint: Free the young girl with a staff fragment to receive her broach. Another valid supplied broach works too.

steps.text: Carry 1 x an elegant silver broach
steps.hint: Free the Lady with a staff fragment to receive her silver broach. Use the crying ghost's elegant key to reach her rooms, or another valid route.

steps.text: Return all three keepsakes to Lord Krimeneha
steps.hint: His office is off the library. He rewards a silver bastard sword and the heavy key for his upstairs iron vault. The key opens the vault container; finding and reaching the vault room is a separate task.

introduction: Investigate the poisoned gardens, free the sane spirits and reunite Lord Krimeneha's family through their keepsakes.
orientation: Ask the gardeners about the pool and their lord, then ask Lord Krimeneha about Eckraldu. These conversations explain the curse.
One staff fragment can support several rescues. Keep the family's three keepsakes for the lord; other spirit rescues remain separate accomplishments.
Several doors and treasure containers use different keys. The checklist shows supplies and accepted exchanges; it does not prove a personal kill, learned topic or lock opening.
